note: Additions to the proofreading lists built into proof.js. extraMisspellings maps a wrong spelling (lower case) to the right one; extraBrandTerms are KONE names as KONE writes them (a word one letter off is reported); extraUsUk adds [US, UK] pairs for the mixed-spelling check; ignore lists words never to report. The built-in lists stay in force — this file only adds to them.
